study: Polymarket CLOB V2 order vectors for the order path (2026-10-01): eight orders (BUY and SELL, standard and neg-risk exchange, all six tick sizes) built, hashed and signed offline by Polymarket's own TypeScript client with Hardhat's published test key #0, two cancel bodies with their L2 signatures, and 24 rounding cases; cross-checked against the official Python client
pinned_by: supabase/functions/agents/polymarket_orders.test.ts (every hash, signature, amount and body byte for byte)
run: npm ci --ignore-scripts && node gen_vectors.mjs > vectors.json  # offline after the install; byte-identical on re-run (timestamp, salt and randomness fixed per case)
python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python check_py.py > check_py_out.txt  # offline; 3 differences, all rounding (the Python client floors floats)
